collections.name: users
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == document;

collections.name: procedures
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null && (resource == null || resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid) && (request.resource == null || request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid);

collections.name: procedures/{procedureId}/amendments
collections.rules: allow read, create: if request.auth != null; allow update, delete: if false;

collections.name: procedures/{procedureId}/vitals
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null;

collections.name: procedures/{procedureId}/medications
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null;

collections.name: procedures/{procedureId}/fluids
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null;

collections.name: procedures/{procedureId}/infusions
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null;

collections.name: procedures/{procedureId}/clinicalEvents
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null;

collections.name: procedures/{procedureId}/transfers
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null;

collections.name: worklist
collections.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null;
